blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former President Rodrigo Duterte’s defense team before the International Criminal Court (ICC) is considering using an artificial intelligence (AI) tool to sift through the massive volume of evidence disclosed by prosecutors, but said the service could cost nearly €500,000. Duterte’s lead counsel, Peter Haynes, raised the possibility during the third status conference of ICC Trial Chamber III, where he described the prosecution’s disclosure as “unworkable” and a “terrible mess.” Haynes said the prosecution had so far “dumped” around 62,500 exhibits with the Registry, amounting to about 324,000 pages of evidence and more than 1,000 video and audio files […]...
